helpClickEntities: Click a box (entity) or a connection to open that item's details — connections show their topic and sources.
helpMiddleClick: Click with the middle mouse button to reset the zoom and frame the whole graph.

helpDragBox: Drag a box to reposition the entity; its neighbours follow while you drag.
helpDragBackground: Drag the background to move around the map.

ogCardPreviewHelp: Image used when this map is shared on social networks. It is regenerated whenever the map is saved.

authNotConfigured: Authentication is not configured. Set ADMIN_LOGIN and ADMIN_PASSWORD on the server.
authSessionExpired: The login form expired. Please try again.
mapListHelp: Pick a map to preview it here.
mapPreviewEmpty: No map selected yet. Pick a map from the list to see the graph.
mapRelationsHelp: These are the relations saved in this map. Edit, add or remove lines and press Process to save.
createMapHelp: The map is created empty and opened for editing.
settingsSiteLogoHelp: Optional. Shown in the header instead of the site title.
settingsFaviconHelp: Optional. Used as the browser tab icon.
settingsThemeColorLightHelp: Mobile browser toolbar color for the light theme.
settingsThemeColorDarkHelp: Mobile browser toolbar color for the dark theme.
settingsMapPathPrefixHelp: Directory used by public map links, e.g. /m/abcxyz. Lowercase letters, digits, "-" and "_" only.
settingsMapShortIdLengthHelp: Random characters in new map links (3-32, default 6).
settingsMapShortIdUppercase: Allow uppercase letters in new map links
settingsMapShortIdNumbers: Allow digits in new map links
settingsMapShortIdHelp: Only affects links created from now on. Existing links never change.
settingsRobotsEnabledHelp: Published at /robots.txt using the content below.
settingsSitemapEnabledHelp: Lists the home page and every public map.
settingsSiteUrlHelp: Used for canonical links, OpenGraph URLs and the sitemap. Falls back to the DOMAIN environment variable.
settingsOgImageHelp: Optional image shown when a page is shared on social networks.
settingsOgCardEnabled: Generate an OpenGraph image per map
settingsOgCardEnabledHelp: Every map gets its own 1200x630 image (title, description, counts and a sketch of the network), regenerated when the map changes. Used by the map pages and by the home preview; the default image above is the fallback.
settingsTwitterSiteHelp: Optional. Rendered as the twitter:site meta tag.
settingsCustomHeadHelp: Raw HTML injected inside the head of every page.
settingsCustomCssHelp: Inline CSS added to every page.
settingsCustomJsHelp: Inline JavaScript added before the closing body tag.
maintenanceHelp: These actions create content for the saved maps. Existing maps are never changed.
confirmSeedMap: Create a new map with the example data?
maintenanceRegenerateCardsHelp: Run this after changing the site title, the domain or the default theme: all of those are painted on every card.
mapsAdminHelp: Edit the title, description and visibility here. Open a map to edit its relations.
errorMapTitleRequired: A title is required to save a map.
errorSettingsInvalidPrefix: The map URL directory may only contain lowercase letters, digits, "-" and "_".
